author: Marlon Chaviano
name: api-rails
title: API with Rails
description: Rails 8 in API mode: JSON only, no views, with Active Record, migrations, tests and optional RSpec.

base.command: command -v rails >/dev/null || { echo 'Rails is required: gem install rails' >&2; exit 1; }; rails new {{name}} --api --skip-git --skip-bundle --skip-kamal --skip-thruster

verify.command: bin/rails db:prepare && bin/rails test && bin/rails zeitwerk:check && (test ! -d spec || bundle exec rspec)

instructions:
## How to work here

- It's an API: controllers inherit from `ActionController::API` and respond with JSON. Generate resources with `bin/rails g scaffold <Model> field:type`.
- Database changes only through migrations (`bin/rails g migration`), never by editing `schema.rb`.
- Before finishing: `bin/rails test`.
